subject: general
question: In November 2025, which Indian state rolled out the amended Bharat Net Scheme across its territory, aiming in part to support real-time monitoring in sensitive border zones affected by regional disputes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **November 2025**, the state government of **Punjab** rolled out the **amended Bharat Net Scheme** to provide high-speed fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) connectivity across its rural landscape.
 
• The primary objective of this rollout in **Punjab** is to facilitate **real-time monitoring** in **sensitive border zones**. This is critical for detecting **unmanned aerial vehicles (drones)** and preventing **cross-border smuggling** along the international boundary.
 
• The **amended Bharat Net** model focuses on a **Public-Private Partnership (PPP)** approach, ensuring that the infrastructure is not only built but also **maintained for high uptime** and efficiency over the long term.
